notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{R} and by exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's first ability by paying {B} and sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, causing yourself to mill three cards.
Repeat.
